inference_boundary: exploratory literature-driven screen; not preregistered confirmatory inference

fixed_upstream.v6_core_derivation: scripts/literature/derive_v22_core_fcp_universe_v6.py; focal-taxon guard removes Viola sieheana leakage and yields 74 species

screen.conditional_model: documentation-IPW L2 multinomial; metric + geographic_radius_95; family bootstrap
screen.total_hypervolume: PC1-PC3 convex-hull volume rarefied to 20 occupied climate cells; 99 draws
screen.regional_hypervolume_diagnostics: two spherical-KMeans geographic sectors; normalized PC1-PC3 centroid separation and Gaussian Bhattacharyya overlap
screen.fragmentation: mean of 1-largest-component-fraction across 100, 250 and 500 km DBSCAN connectivity thresholds
screen.spatial_niche_turnover: normalized difference in PC1-PC3 environmental distance between upper and lower quartiles of within-species geographic distance

results.H1a_mean_BIO4: candidate only: S_vs_C OR 0.349, family-bootstrap CI 0.085-0.909; interval crosses 1 after mean-temperature or absolute-latitude controls
results.H2_fragmentation: directionally positive for S/mixed but unsupported
results.H3_spatial_niche_structure: unsupported across pairwise turnover, regional centroid separation and regional Gaussian overlap
results.H0_total_hypervolume: does not cleanly discriminate C/S organization

next_decisive_test: dynamic year-specific/flowering-season climate and temporal hypervolume turnover; BIO4 is climatological seasonality, not observed interannual temporal exposure
